summary: LogProstyle Inc., a Tokyo-based NYSE American-listed foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing payment of the second quarterly installment of its previously declared cash dividend. The US$0.0115 per share installment was paid October 30, 2026 to holders of record September 30, 2026, representing the second tranche of a US$0.046 per share annual dividend declared by the Board on July 13, 2026. Remaining installments of US$0.0115 each are scheduled for January 29, 2027 and April 30, 2027. Japanese withholding of 15.315% applies to non-residents. No special-situation event; routine dividend mechanics with no risk-arb angle.
